data_exclusion: Exclude all copies in every exact-content group assigned conflicting labels, consistently before all splits/configs. TrashNet glass176.jpg and plastic152.jpg share identical bytes but different labels; retain raw files and old pilot. No outcome-based exclusion.
split_method: Class-stratified grouping by exact image SHA256; all byte-identical copies stay together. Approximate 80/10/10; no source-object/near-duplicate guarantee.
classwise: all classes, canister explicitly retained even if zero
sample_size_basis: Finite crossed design of three split levels and three model-seed levels to inspect sign/rank and optimization/split sensitivity. Resource-bounded development replication, not a formal power claim. No optional stopping or selective exclusions.
inference_scope: Splits overlap in input images; nine runs are not nine independent datasets. Report paired differences by split and seed; no naive iid p-values or winner-only reporting.
training_recipe: Byte-identical experiment.py and model sources to corrected pilot, including AdamW, clipping1, smoothing.1, 100epochs/patience20; only split/config/seed inventory differs.
selection_bias: Configs informed by completed pilot; new retraining/splits improve stability assessment but do not create an untouched test set or establish algorithm novelty.
resource_policy: At most two workers per GPU, four total, first-epoch and GPU admission checks; wait for DKD post-primary measurements AND aggregation completion; stop new jobs on failures; no automatic retry.
